text:
deploy-bot: starting v2 rollout 2.1.0 -> eu-west-1 small-batch warmup at 08:00 UTC, 10% traffic. watching prober and kv-cache metrics. please ack.
Alex: ACK. quick check — seeing prober 95p creeping up already.
Maria: saw a tiny 503 bump for mobile clients, looks like cold-kv + warmup overlap.
Ops-Jen: @Alex can you paste a small log snippet from the prober run?
Alex: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T08:03:12Z prober eu-west-1 latency 1240ms p95
2026-03-21T08:03:17Z kvcache miss spikes 60%
2026-03-21T08:03:45Z response 503 count +12
```
Sam: I'm leaning safety-hold + pin affected tenants. deploy-bot, can you pause the canary?
deploy-bot: paused rollout at 10% in eu-west-1 per operator request (sam). canary pause flag set. reason: prober latency spike and kv miss pattern. rollout link: https://deploy.internal/release/1768888888
Maria: propose temporary client header pin for tenant-A, tenant-B, tenant-C so we reduce blast. Ops to apply.
Ops-Jen: prepping pinlist now, ETA ~10m. will also update release notes with warmup guidance and recommended retries.
Release-Engineer: I'll update release notes and changelog. Suggest adding rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency > 1s.
Sam: rollback plan? full revert to v1, or shift traffic to v1 just for pinned tenants?
Alex: prefer traffic-shift to v1 for affected tenants (sticky routing) rather than full revert — less churn and faster recovery.
Ops-Jen: pinlist applied: tenant-A tenant-B tenant-C. traffic shifted for those tenants. monitoring: https://metrics.internal/rollout/1768888888
Maria: pushed a release notes edit: callout about warmup + KV prefill suggestions for SDKs. also note the client header negotiation update.
Sam: :thumbsup: keep eyes for 30m. if error rate doesn't normalize we escalate to rollback.
Ops-Jen: confirming error rate dropped back to baseline after the pin/shift.
Alex: filing follow-up task: add pre-warm lambda + KV prefill job to reduce cold-start tail. PR link to follow.
deploy-bot: thread closed by operator (sam). all actions logged in rollout audit.
